reviews.text: Kris is very nice and helpful, answers all questions. You can’t go wrong using his services. He’s very professional, and explains everything to you. I had questions after it ran for the first time, we called with more questions. He called back and answered all our new questions. Very satisfied. Would highly recommend him to family and friends.

reviews.author: Joseph Layton
reviews.text: Kris is one of the best people I have met. On top of being an electrician. He was there hours trying to diagnose the problem with our power and when he went under the house found out we had a major water leak that was going on our junction box. Even after he was down there the pipe completely burst and he got soaked he finished the job. So we are thankful to him because not only did he fix our issue he found another that needed addressing and if it weren't for him our home could have been gone. And very reasonable price. I would recommend him and karrickers to anyone.

reviews.author: Andrew B
reviews.text: I highly recommend Kris from Karrikers. He was very thorough not only taking care of the annual maintenance on my Generac generator but also corrected a few things the original installer from another company had done incorrectly. Honest, friendly and dependable!
